args.body:
Summary of websites posted to 'general' channel:

1. www.informations.com (shared by Bob):
   - The latest job report brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com (shared by Eve):
   - Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery nestled in the heart of the city, renowned for its authentic Swiss cuisine.
   - Menu features traditional Swiss dishes including cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert.
   - Warm wooden interiors adorned with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere.
   - Guests can enjoy stunning panoramic views of the city skyline through large windows.
   - Friendly staff dressed in traditional Swiss attire provide an authentic Alpine dining experience.

Both websites were mentioned in general channel messages, with Bob sharing an article about job reports and Eve mentioning the restaurant for lunch.

Hi Dora! I checked out your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice personal site! I'd suggest adding a bit more about your projects or interests to give visitors a better sense of who you are. Looking forward to seeing it grow!

Hi Eve! I checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's great that you love hiking! Maybe you could add some recent trip stories, photos, or gear recommendations to engage readers more. Keep up the good work!
